# Apple Music

Apple's music streaming service, built into the iPhone, Mac and HomePod ecosystem.

## Market position

#2 globally after Spotify: **~12.6% of the subscription market** (MIDiA, 2025) vs Spotify's ~31.7%. Apple hasn't published official numbers since 2023 (estimated ~100M subscribers).

## Features vs Spotify

- **Lossless + Spatial Audio (Dolby Atmos) at no extra cost since June 2021** — while Spotify HiFi, announced in February 2021, never launched as a separate tier (lossless only reached Spotify in 2025).
- Deep integration with the Apple ecosystem (Siri, HomePod, Watch).
- No free ad-supported plan — trial only.

## Comparison

| Category | Where they stand |
|---|---|
| Price (individual) | **$10.99/mo** (US) — a dollar under Spotify since Spotify's 2024 rise ([Apple Music](https://www.apple.com/apple-music/)) |
| Free tier | None — paid only, trial aside |
| Audio quality | Lossless + Spatial Audio (Dolby Atmos) at no extra cost since June 2021 ([Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2021/05/apple-music-announces-spatial-audio-and-lossless-audio/)) |
| Algorithm control | The recurring complaint runs the other way — discovery rated weaker than Discover Weekly "in the good days" (see User voices) |
| Library & ownership | Your own files can live alongside streaming — upload/match via the iCloud music library |

## User voices

- The audio-quality argument was for years the main thread in "Spotify vs Apple Music" comparisons — Apple delivered lossless for free, Spotify made people wait ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/advice/spotify-hifi-quality-price-release-date-free-trial-and-latest-news)).
- Typical reason to switch: quality + price in the Apple One family bundle; typical complaint: weaker music discovery than Discover Weekly "in the good days".

## What this means for our personas

- The "I pay the same but get better quality for the money" argument lands with [The Value Auditor](../Archetypes/The%20Value%20Auditor.md).
- For Emma (iPhone, passive listening) the exit barrier is the cost of migrating playlists — see [Sister has Apple Music](../Signals/Sister%20has%20Apple%20Music.md).
